exposure: Oral lactoferrin (two capsules per day for five days, then one capsule per day for ten days, followed by 1 capsule per day for 10 days per month)
cohort: The study included 66 cases of women with a history of recurrent bacterial vaginosis in third trimester singleton pregnancy, divided into a lactoferrin group and a control group.
finding: Treatment with oral lactoferrin in patients with recurrent bacterial vaginosis significantly reduced the incidence of low APGAR1, preterm birth, CS delivery, low birth weight, and premature rupture of membranes.
mod_finding: CS delivery type was significantly higher in the control group compared to the group treated with lactoferrin.
